notes.title: Comet Clash 1.0 RELEASED!
notes.notes:
CADETS!

The time has come to man your stations!

[b]We are proud to announce that [i]Comet Clash[/i] has been released![/b]

It has been a wonderful adventure developing this game. Don't fear it'll end here because we have YOU to save our collective asses from imminent destruction! We are still working on a few things like

[list]
[*] Proper and native Gamepad Support
[*] A loading screen
[*] More leaderboards
[*] Socials
[/list]

As said in our previous announcement, we've learned about the software we use along the way, there's a (slight) chance you'll encounter a bug or two. Don't hesitate to inform us.

Now go on, play the game we've put our hearts and souls in, cadet.

Enjoy!

bitshift.studio

notes.title: Man Your Station, Space Cadet!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44169906/a980a4744abc63e517d1970c796ae12df0ead1a8.png[/img]
Gamers!

After a years long journey into Blender, Unreal Engine and Game Development in general, we're finally ready to release our first [strike]serious[/strike] game.

[b]We're proud to announce that Comet Clash 1.0 will be released on April 20th of this year! Please take this chance to enjoy a 35% Release Discount![/b]

As we've learned about the software we use along the way, there's a (slight) chance you'll encounter a bug or two. Please consider helping us fix these by reporting them. There's information about how to contact us in the Credits section of the Main Menu. Don't hesitate to do so.

Currently we're in the process of setting up our online presence like Discord, Steam community, and our website. There will be plenty of ways to get to know us.

We've been working very hard to get this game ready for release and we hope you'll enjoy playing it as much as we did developing it.

Best regards and good luck,

bitshift.studio
